edit_lock: Use the attached ink drawing as a locked source. Preserve exact canvas size, framing, camera, positions, scale, pose, silhouette and every ink mark. Change only color beneath the drawing. Do not crop, outpaint, recompose or add objects.
colour_prompt: Color the existing black-and-white comic drawing as a clean educational historical illustration. Preserve all black linework, hatching and cross-hatching exactly. Apply color only as a second pass beneath the ink. Use a restrained watercolor-comic treatment with transparent washes, subtle pigment variation and a bright editorial feel. Keep major architectural surfaces very light, mostly cream, pale sandstone, warm off-white and light ochre. Use weathered brown for wood and boats, clear muted turquoise or blue-green for water, and restrained olive only for vegetation. Use selective color placement rather than coloring every surface. Keep background areas quieter and less saturated. Black ink must remain dominant. Preserve generous light areas and negative space, with roughly 35 to 45% of the image remaining very pale. No muddy wash, no antique filter, no glossy rendering, no heavy grunge, no green architecture and no repainting of linework.
cloud_addendum: Keep clouds primarily the white of the paper, with 80–90% of each cloud untouched. Add only an extremely pale transparent cool blue-grey wash beneath selected lower edges and overlaps. Surround them with a very pale blue watercolor sky. Preserve thin cloud contours. No solid white or grey fill, detailed internal texture, heavy shadows, airbrushed gradients, photographic clouds or 3D rendering.
pass1: Draw [historical scene, period, location, action] as a clean black-and-white educational comic illustration. Use [framing] and the supplied references for their assigned roles. Use crisp black contours, controlled hatching and cross-hatching only in the deepest shadows. Keep broad areas of white paper and a clear focal action. Draw clouds as large irregular cumulus silhouettes with very thin contours, few overlapping forms and nearly white interiors. No color, grey washes, dense cloud shading, text, labels or watermarks.
geometry_lock: Color only things already drawn. Keep dry ground almost white; never introduce water or wave marks. Keep every part of a sculpture—including face, hair and hands—the same stone or metal material. Preserve counted ropes, flag bands, objects, attachments and openings. Use quiet broad washes without added surface patterns.
hatching_rule: approximately 10 to 14% black coverage. Use single-direction hatching for medium shadows and no more than two intersecting directions for deep shadows. Keep 65 to 75% white space. Cross-hatching should occupy no more than 20% of the shaded area.
